title: Great Barrier Reef Bleaching Returns Every 2 Years
hook: Bleaching now returns before the Great Barrier Reef can recover.
closing: Repeated bleaching can destroy recovery before damaged coral has time to rebuild.
question: Can the reef recover in time?

segments.say: The reef suffered 3 bleaching events this decade, turning a rare crisis into a recurring threat.
The reef now gets only 2 years between bleachings, leaving damaged coral little time to rebuild.
Reef recovery typically needs 10 years, so the next bleaching can arrive long before healing finishes.
